# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> Díolta Estate Agency are delighted to present 55 Castle Avenue, an exceptional A1-rated two-bedroom mid-terrace home located within the highly sought-after Hereford Park development in Leixlip. Beautifully presented throughout, this contemporary home combines stylish interiors, outstanding energy efficiency and a thoughtfully designed layout to create a property that is ready for its new buyers.

- Lokalita: 55 Castle Avenue, Hereford Park, Leixlip
